title: DOW-UAP-D64, Mission Report, Iran, November 2020
doc_notes: This document is a declassified U.S. military Mission Report (MISREP) detailing UAP observations in the Arabian Gulf region on November 2, 2020, featuring significant redactions under 1.4(a) and other FOIA exemptions.

incidents.summary: U.S. military operator observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon while on an ISR mission.
U.S. military operator observed a second unidentified aerial phenomenon traveling northwest.
